entries.title: Solutions Platform Overview
entries.answer: The Vortexus solutions platform organizes water, pumping, treatment, and energy systems into practical solution families. It connects borehole performance, pump systems, domestic treatment, industrial purification, chemicals, media, and solar-powered water infrastructure.

entries.title: Water Access and Delivery Solutions
entries.answer: Water access and delivery solutions include boreholes, water pumps, and solar-driven water movement systems. These are aimed at operational reliability where water supply, abstraction, transfer, or pressure stability matters.

entries.title: Treatment and Purification Solutions
entries.answer: Treatment and purification solutions include domestic water treatment, commercial and industrial water treatment, and chemicals and media. The correct approach depends on water quality, output use, flow, contamination problem, and whether the user needs pretreatment, polishing, disinfection, or desalination.
